SpeechSynthesisUtterance

Baseline Widely available

The SpeechSynthesisUtterance interface of the Web Speech API represents a speech request. It contains the content the speech service should read and information about how to read it, such as language, pitch and volume.

Constructor

The constructor returns a new utterance instance whose text property is set to the given string.

Events

Listen to the boundary event to find out when the speech reaches a word or sentence boundary, and to the end event to know when the utterance has finished.

Browser compatibility

Chrome 33
